basics.description:
**Automate malware & phishing analysis and enrich Defender alerts with ANY.RUN Sandbox findings.**

[ANY.RUN’s Interactive Sandbox](https://any.run/features/?utm_source=ms-defender-marketplace-sb&utm_medium=ms-defender-marketplace-sb&utm_campaign=ms-defender-marketplace-sb&utm_content=linktosandboxlanding) integrates seamlessly with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) to streamline alert triage, accelerate threat investigation, and eliminate manual analysis overhead for SOC teams and incident responders.

**Key Benefits**

* Accelerate Alert Triage & Response: Automatically submit suspicious files and URLs extracted from MDE alerts directly to ANY.RUN for real-time detonation.
* Real-Time Behavioral Context: Receive immediate verdicts, malware family tags, extracted IOCs, network traffic details, and direct links to live interactive analysis sessions within your Microsoft Defender workflow.
* Automated SOC Playbooks: Configure flexible automated submission rules based on alert properties to handle high-volume threats with minimal manual intervention.
* Seamless Threat Intelligence Integration: Store and correlate newly discovered IOCs directly in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint for proactive enterprise-wide defense.

**Connector’s functionality**

The connector triggers automatically upon the registration of a new alert in MDE, extracting and analyzing entities such as URLs or files associated with the alert.

* Alert comments include the ANY.RUN verdict, threat score, a link to the detailed analysis report, and any IOCs discovered during the sandbox detonation
* Extracted IOCs can also be imported into Microsoft Defender for Endpoint as indicators for enhanced detection and response

**Why ANY.RUN?**

Unlike traditional static or non-interactive sandboxes, ANY.RUN offers true interactive cloud-based malware analysis. Security analysts can actively interact with suspicious sessions in real time, clicking links, bypassing CAPTCHAs, running command-line utilities, and observing malware behavior as it unfolds inside a secure virtual environment.

By combining high-speed automated detonation with instant interactive access, ANY.RUN enables security teams to drastically reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Respond (MTTR), improve SLA stability, and handle complex multi-stage attacks with full visibility.

basics.name: instanceName
basics.label: Instance name
basics.toolTip: Used in the names of all resources of this deployment. Keep the suggested random value to create a new instance, or enter the name of an existing instance to update it. 1-12 lowercase letters and digits.

options.text: Resource names use this instance, for example ANYRUN-Sandbox-MDE-<instance>-LA and ANYRUN-Sandbox-MDE-<instance>-<hash>-FA. The suggested random name creates a new instance. To update an existing instance, enter its name (see the Instance tag on its resources).
Requires permission to create role assignments on the resource group: Owner, User Access Administrator or Role Based Access Control Administrator.

The selected region has not been confirmed as supporting Azure Functions Flex Consumption. Wait for the region list to load. If this message persists, check Microsoft.Web access or choose another region.
To create an app registration: Microsoft Entra ID > App registrations > New registration. Use a dedicated app registration for this connector.

To grant API permissions: your app registration > API permissions > Add a permission > APIs my organization uses > WindowsDefenderATP > Application permissions: Alert.ReadWrite.All, Machine.LiveResponse, Machine.ReadWrite.All, Ti.ReadWrite, Library.Manage > Grant admin consent.
To create a client secret: your app registration > Certificates & secrets > Client secrets > New client secret. Copy the secret Value (not the Secret ID) into the Client secret field below.

To enable Live Response: Microsoft Defender portal > Settings > Endpoints > Advanced features > turn on Live Response, Live Response for Servers and Live Response unsigned script execution. The connector uses Live Response to collect evidence files from devices.
